title: IMMORTAL
overview: The story centers on a young man, Appu, born into a mafia family and enamored by the tales of underworld legends. He sets himself the mission of assassinating the ruthless gangster Mrithyumjayam, a man rumored to be “immortal”, having survived bullets, stabbings and decades at the top of the food chain. The question looms: can Appu kill the man who can’t die and thereby make a name for himself?
